newsitem.title: UK: St Ives shares up as results meet forecasts.
newsitem.headline: St Ives shares up as results meet forecasts.

text.p: Shares in printing group St Ives Plc rose on Tuesday after annual pretax profits met with analysts expectations.
By 0815 GMT, the shares were up 10-1/2p at 458-1/2p.
Pretax profits improved to 42.2 million stg, up from 35.5 million previously.
Analysts had been forecasting profits of between 39.6-43.0 million stg.

Analysts expressed relief that the company was able to produce solid earnings growth despite a difficult trading environment. But they said it was unlikely that the results would prompt them to revise next year's earnings estimates.
In a statement accompanying the results St Ives said that the outlook is encouraging, given the upturn in consumer spending in the UK.
